description: Erection of a replacement single storey rear infill, side and rear extension and second floor extension to the existing two storey rear outrigger, and alterations to the existing rear roof dormer extension to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PL-004 (Rev B)  Received:  16 November 2022;  PL-002 (Rev B)  Received:  31 October 2022;  PL-000; PL-001  Received:  20 September 2022;  PL-003  Received:  19 August 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey rear infill, side and rear extension, second storey extension to the two storey rear outrigger and altered rear roof dormer extension hereby approved.
